Go to the linked website and submit a request to download your account data.
Go to the URL provided above and submit a request.

Contact the customer support and request your data.

Depending on you area you must follow the instructions shown in 'https://www.alibabagroup.com/en/contact/law_e_commerce?spm=a271m.8038972.0.0.5a916d82MwfIzm'

Amazon asks you to sign in again here. Choose the information you want ("Request All Your Data" covers everything), then Submit Request. Click the link in the email Amazon sends: a request that isn't confirmed is never started. The download link arrives by email, usually within a day.

Sign in, choose Request a copy of your data, tick what you want, then Continue. If it asks for a largest file size, the biggest means fewer parts. Apple checks it's you, then puts the files on this page and tells you. You have 14 days to download them.
Go to the url provided above and submit a data request at the bottom of the page
Go to the url provided above and submit a request, picking 'General question' as subject, or send an email to DPO@corp.badoo.com.
Select the information you want to download. You will need to enter an email verification code and a 2FA code if enabled.
On 'My profile' section, click on 'Security and privacy'. Go to 'Privacy and Data', click on 'Get Portability' and wait until it's done.
Make sure not to skip signin to make the process faster.
According to privacy policy (item 8), you have to send an e-mail to them requesting the data.
You have to contact with service support

Fill in your name and email, choose "Right to obtain a copy of my personal data" (in some places "Right of access to personal data"), then Submit request. Open the link in the email Booking.com sends within 24 hours and click Confirm request. The report comes by email, within the time the law allows (up to 30 or 45 days).
U.S. and Canada residents can fill out the linked web form or email privacy@rbi.com
Fill your account's email and the captcha below, then click "Show My Data" and save the single-page PDF.

In the mobile app, go to Account > Communications & privacy > Privacy Rights and fill out the provided privacy web form (privacyportal.onetrust.com). U.S. residents can also send an email to privacy@chick-fil-a.com or call 1-866-232-2040; Canadian residents must email privacy.canada@chick-fil-a.com.
Go to Settings → Privacy → "Export data." Your account data will be compiled and made available for download with a single click.
Cloudflare only accepts access requests via email.
For your transactions: on coinbase.com, Statements → Transaction history → Generate report, as CSV. For everything else on your account, request your data in the Privacy section (the guide above).
Craigslist's Download my data form. Sign in so it knows it's you, then fill it in and send it. Without an account, email ccpa@craigslist.org.
In the Day One app: on a Mac, File → Export → JSON; on an iPhone, Settings → Import/Export → Export Day One JSON. You get a zip with a .json file a journal and your photos.

The GDPR link is not shown publicly - you must know the URL directly. The data provided is very limited (no private messages, no comments on arts, only basic account information like username, email, and IP addresses). Account deactivation available at https://www.deviantart.com/settings/deactivation but no account deletion option found.
You have to log into your Discord account, go to 'Settings > Privacy and security' and click on 'Request all my data'.
Request an archive of your data from DoorDash's privacy page (help.doordash.com links to it). DoorDash emails when the zip is ready: its consumer_order_details.csv has everything you ordered.

Sign in at duolingo.com first, then open this page again: Data Vault doesn't send you there and back. Ask for a copy of your data (the same page can delete your account: not that button). Duolingo says it can take up to 30 days.
Sign in, then Request a download under Download your EA data (EA Account → Security and Privacy). It's usually ready in under two hours: download it from the same page.
Go to your account settings, then click on "Request your eBay data", follow the simple steps and in 7 days you should receive your data back
Contact the customer support via email and request a copy of your data.
Contact the customer support using the form or via email and request your data.
Go to your account settings, then click on 'Download Account Information' button to receive your data
In the Evernote app on your Mac: right-click a notebook → Export Notebook… → ENEX. One .enex file a notebook: export each one you want.

Go to the profile icon, click "Settings & privacy", then "Settings", and click "See more in Accounts Center". You can access a summary of your data or download a copy. The data are categorized by type to help the search. You can download it in JSON or HTML formats.
You will be asked to upload photo id after the initial form submission.
Click the link sent to your email if you requested a full archive.
Send an email requesting a copy of your data to privacy-officer@freelancer.com.
Sign in to your Garmin Account, then Data Management → Export Your Data → Request Data Export. Garmin emails a link when the zip is ready, usually within a few days.
According with item 11.IV, you have to send an e-mail to privacyrights@gettr.com. And even sending the e-mail, they may refuse the request and not send the data.
Settings → Account → Export account data → Start export. GitHub emails a download link to your primary address. It lasts 7 days and may ask for your password again.
Since Gmail is a service by Google, please refer to the instructions for Google.
After signing in, go to Account Settings → Download Your Information. You'll receive a file containing your account info including name, email, and address.
Go to the url provided above and submit a request or send an email to privacy@gog.com.

On goodreads.com (the phone app can't export): My Books → Import and export → Export Library. A link, Your export from <date>, appears under the button within seconds: click it to download goodreads_library_export.csv, your shelves, ratings, reviews and the dates you finished each book.

Go to Google Takeout (takeout.google.com) while logged in to a Google Account and select the data from every Google Service you need/want and click "Next Step". Then you can choose between export now or once every 2 months for 1 year, the file type and size. Click "Create Export" and wait until the process is finished. Then, just download your data.
While logged in click on your email, then "Account settings", then "Security & data" and export your data.

Log in to your HUAWEI ID and then click Privacy Centre > Request Your Data. When you request a copy of your data, Huawei will prepare the data you have requested. After the data is ready, you can download it to your device and will be available for 21 days. If you need to download the data after the expiry date, you need to submit a new request.
Contact the customer support via email and request a copy of your data.
Go to the URL above and submit a request. Image of government-issued ID is required.

On imdb.com, open Your Ratings, then the ⋮ menu → Export; do the same on your Watchlist and on each of your lists. IMDb makes the files in a minute or two and lists them here, under Your exports: download each CSV.
Go to the url provided and press the Download button under Privacy.
Click "Create Export", and then choose where and what to export. Check the help center page (help.instagram.com) for more information.
On instapaper.com, Settings → Export → Download .CSV file. instapaper-export.csv downloads straight away: every article you saved, the folder it's in and when you saved it.
Requires Microsoft Excel or equivalent to open.
According to item 12, you have to send an e-mail to privacy@kwai.com, with your Kwai ID user to request your data.
Settings → Data → Export your data, then Export data. A zip, letterboxd-<username>-<date>-utc.zip, downloads straight away: your diary, reviews, ratings, watchlist, likes and lists.
Send an email requesting a copy of your data.
Send an email requesting a copy of your data.

1.-Click the Me icon at the top of your LinkedIn homepage. 2.-Select Settings & Privacy from the dropdown. 3.-Click the Data Privacy on the left rail. 4.-Under the How LinkedIn uses your data section, click Get a copy of your data. 5.-Select the data that you’re looking for and Request archive.
Check the boxes under the "Personal Data Disclosure" section
Send an email to sac@lolja.com.br with all relevant information (name, email address, etc).
Send an email requesting a copy of your data.
Sign in with the code Lyft texts you, then click Start under Download Data. Lyft emails when it's ready, usually in a few days. US and Canada only.
Log in to your account -> Go to 'Settings'-> 'Account' -> 'Back-up'.
Wikipedia's data access is easy, but other data from Wikimedia like donation history can only be retrieved through email to privacy@wikimedia.org

Log in and navigate to Settings → Security. Under "Download your personal data," click the "Download" button to receive a file with your account and metadata. Note: This does not include your stored files, only metadata and account info.

Sign in, then Download your data → Create new archive. It's ready on the same page under Archives (there's no email), as a zip of JSON files. It has your activity: searches, browsing, location and app use. Outlook mail and OneDrive have their own exports. For everything else Microsoft holds, ask at account.microsoft.com/privacy/privacy-request (Export my data).
The only way to contact them is by email, but no one responds.
Send an email requesting a copy of your data.
Go to the url provided abobe and click on 'See here for Data Subject Access Requests' and fill a form or send an email to compliance@mozilla.com.

To exercise the right to request access to, or copies of, your Relevant Personal Data, together with information regarding the nature, Processing and disclosure of those Relevant Personal Data, or others of your rights, or to ask a question about these rights or any other provision of Privacy Policy, or about our Processing of your Personal Data, please use the contact privacy-eu@msi.com.

name: Mujirushi Ryōhin (Muji) / Ryohin Keikaku Co., Ltd.

export.notes: Contact the customer support via email and ask to access your data. You should use the email of the country where you are registered: it's in the contacts, at the bottom of the website.
Choose Anime List, then Export My List, and download the file it offers (animelist_<numbers>.xml.gz). Do it again with Manga List for your manga.

Sign in (Netflix may send a code first), then Submit Request and confirm it from the email Netflix sends. Netflix emails when it's ready, within 30 days. Only the account owner can ask: with just a profile on someone else's account, email privacy@netflix.com.
Select information request under request type. Request can also be completed via telephone (+1 855-822-9548).
Click the link above and fill the form to confirm the request.
Contact the customer support via email and request a copy of your data.
You can send an email to dsar@openai.com or just click in Settings > Data Controls > Export Data. The link sent by e-mail will expire within 24 hours.
According to privacy policy (item 8), you have to send an e-mail to them requesting the data.

Hover over More Pages then click on login, then go to account settings scroll down and u see Download my data then just press the download button then enter your password and all the data asociated to your account will be downloaded.

Take Control → Download all my data, then sign in to Patreon to show it's you. It's usually ready within minutes (Patreon allows up to 30 days). The link comes by email and the report stays there for 14 days.

Settings → Data & Privacy → Download your data: choose what to include, then Submit Request. For your payments, also download Activity → the download icon → a Custom report as CSV (12 months per file, up to 7 years back).

You will have to send a written request with your passport, or another identification document, to  Av. Europa Parcela 2-3, Pol. Ind. Las Salinas 30840 Alhama de Murcia. You can also request the data throught a e-mail to lopd@pccomponentes.com.

Click on your profile icon, then on "Account Settings", then on "Privacy Settings", then on "Data Access Request", then on "Request Data". You will receive an email with a link to download your data when it is ready.
Select your country and state of residence, then click "Start Access Request" to receive a copy of your account data. This replaces the older email-based request process.
Pocket closed in July 2025, and its exports ended that November. A Pocket export you downloaded before then (a zip with part_000000.csv in it) can still be read: add it here.
U.S. and Canada residents can fill out the linked web form or email privacy@rbi.com

Go to the url provided above and click on the button 'Request a copy of my personal data', at the bottom of the page. They will send you an email to confirm the email address where they will send your data and another to verify your username and password. You will receive your data in about 24 hours.
You can easily contact the team through the contact page or email listed in the site's footer. Data access or deletion requests are handled manually upon request.
Email support@quickseo.ai to request your account data. They will send it to you by email.
In the Raindrop.io app, Settings → Backups → Create new. Raindrop emails you when it's ready; download it from the same page. Of the files, the CSV has your notes, tags and highlights.

Click on getting the data from a range of time or all. Then, wait for the private message in reddit, click in "Download here" and we are done. WARNING: you can only do a data request once every 30 days. You must use the ticket form (reddithelp.com) if you do not have access to your account.
From the app, go to the profile icon, then to "Account" -> "Documents" -> "General" -> "Subject access request". You will get a PDF document with your data.

You would have to make a ticket requesting your data, which will show data recorded on League of Legends, Valorant and Runeterra accounts. After filing a ticket, you have to wait 30 days for an email to be sent to you containing a zipped file, which contains all your data.
In Robinhood: Account → Reports and statements → Reports → generate an account activity report for the dates you want. It takes up to a day; download the CSV from the same page. Crypto isn't in it.
Select "Right of Access" under "Data Privacy Requests". Photo ID is required as proof of residency.
Select "Data access request" for the topic.
Select the services you want to retrieve your data for, or click the first one and click the "All" button at the bottom of the screen.

Sign in at accounts.snapchat.com, then My Data. Turn on Export JSON Files (without it the download is web pages only), choose what to include and All Time, then Submit. Snapchat emails a link, often within a day: download every part (mydata~<numbers>.zip, then -2, -3 ... for memories).
Go to the URL provided above and click on 'Export your Account Data'.
Log into your Spotify account, go to 'Profile > Account > Privacy settings' and follow the steps at the bottom of the page.
On cash.app, sign in, then Activity → Statements → Export CSV. A CSV of your payments, deposits and transfers downloads straight away.
You might need to contact support to get your data deleted from all Stack Exchange network websites. Your posts will be anonymized, not deleted.
U.S. residents should use this form, and Canadian residents should use this form. All others must send an email.

Steam has no single download. Sign in: this page lists your account data by kind (purchases, logins, playtime and more), each on a page of its own. Open the ones you want and save each with File → Save Page As. For anything else, Contact Steam Support with an account data question.
They require two different forms of identification (acceptable documents are Driver's License, Passport, and Student ID card) to process access requests, which are only accepted via email.

The email and phone number you use on the form must be associated with your T-Mobile account. Proof of identity (Driver's License or Passport, New Hampshire residents cannot submit a Driver's License as proof) is required.
Depending on your area you must follow the instructions shown in https://www.alibabagroup.com/en/contact/law_e_commerce?spm=a271m.8038972.0.0.5a916d82MwfIzm'

Only Telegram Desktop can export (not the phone app): Settings → Advanced → Export Telegram data. Choose what to include, set the format to Machine-readable JSON, then Export. If Telegram asks, confirm in the phone app, then export again. It makes a folder, DataExport_<date>, with result.json.
Depending on where you live, you either have to select "Submit a CPRA or VCDPA Data request" or "Submit an EEA Data Request".

On thestorygraph.com, Manage Account → Manage Your Data → Export StoryGraph Library. It makes one CSV of your library (shelves, ratings, reviews, the dates you read each book); download it when it's ready.

On Request data: choose JSON (the default is TXT), click Select all (nothing is ticked to start), then Request data. It's often ready within hours (TikTok allows a few days). Download it from the Download data tab on the same page within 4 days: TikTok emails you a code to type in first.
U.S. and Canada residents can fill out the linked web form or email privacy@rbi.com
Go to the url provided above, log-in with your account credentials and provide and e-mail to receive a link to your data
Depending on your area you must follow the instructions shown in https://www.alibabagroup.com/en/contact/law_e_commerce?spm=a271m.8038972.0.0.5a916d82MwfIzm'
On todoist.com: open a project, then ⋯ → Export as a template → CSV, one project at a time. With Pro, Settings → Backups downloads a zip of every project.
In Data tab in Settings, click the "Export now" button under the Export section. Request will be completed on the spot and download will begin shortly.
On a board: the ⋯ menu → Print, export and share → Export as JSON. One file a board, with its cards, checklists and the last 1,000 comments and changes.

Settings → Privacy → Request Privacy Data (on the web: the apps don't have it). Tumblr emails to check, then again when it's ready, up to 30 days later: download it from the same page. Your posts and media are a separate export: Settings → pick the blog → Export, kept for 3 days.

In Security and Privacy tab on Settings, press "Request a Copy of Your Data" button, select categories and the date range of the data that you want, and submit a request. Request should be completed within 14 days. You will receive Twitch notification once your data is ready to download.
Uber asks you to sign in again here, with a code, even when you're already signed in. Then choose Download your data. Uber emails or texts when it has the request and again when the file is ready.
Scroll down to the bottom of the page and request your data. They will send an email to you once your data download is ready. Emails take up to 24 hours to be sent.
Contact the customer support via email and request a copy of your data.
You have to present a request form through E-mail or in person at the registry with your ID.
Just click in "Clique aqui" and click in "Solicitar envio de dados". An email is sent immediately.
Contact the customer support with the provided form and request your data.
Click "Export User Data". The download will start immediately.
On venmo.com, sign in, then Statements: choose a month and Download CSV, one month at a time. A long one may be emailed instead.
Click on your profile icon, then "Settings", "Privacy settings", "Download account data" and "Request data".

To request your account data, please send an email to info@virtcloud.net with the subject 'Account Data Request'. Include your full name and registered email address. Once verified, a copy of all data associated with your account will be sent to you within 48 hours.

Go to the linked website, make a ZenDesk account, and submit a request to download your account data. IMPORTANT: After VRChat makes your data available, the download URL will be kept active indefinitely, even if you delete your VRChat account at a later date. This effectively means VRChat will still have a copy of your data after account deletion. YOU MUST make a separate request asking for your ZenDesk account, support tickets, and data packages be deleted to fully remove all information from VRChat.
They only accept requests from California and Virginia, but they only check the state selected from the dropdown at the beginning.
Sign in, then on Settings scroll to Download your Personal Information and choose JSON (not HTML): it downloads straight away. For more than this summary, email privacy@wattpad.com.

Only the phone app can ask: Me → Settings → Privacy → My Information & Authorizations → View and Export Personal Data. Give your email, tap OK in the email WeChat sends, then choose the data and submit. A link arrives within 3 business days: open it on this Mac, scan the QR code with WeChat, and unzip the download with the password it shows. Chats aren't kept on WeChat's servers, so it has Moments, Favorites and account details only.

Open the application and go to Settings > Account > Request info. from my account. Select "Request report ", that concludes the process. NOTICE: The report will be ready in approximately 3 days. When it is available, you will have a few weeks to download it. If you delete your account or modify the phone, the request will be canceled.

Wikipedia has no download. Sign in to Wikipedia first, then open this page: it shows your account (sign-up date, groups, edit count and settings) as JSON. Save it with File → Save Page As. Your edits are listed at Special:Contributions.
Visit the linked paged to request your data. After a short while you'll receive an email and you can download your data.

Go to your account settings ("Settings and privacy"), in the "Account" section, click on "Your Twitter data", then enter your password in "Download your Twitter data" and then click "Confirm ". Once the download is ready, they will send you an email to your associated email account and from there you can download a compressed file of your Twitter data.

Go to https://yahoo.mydashboard.oath.com/ with a Yahoo! account, scroll down and select 'Request a download' and on the next page you select all the data you want to download, then add an email that you want notify when the download will be ready, this process may take about 30 days.
You must to send e-mail to datospersonales@yoigo.com with your DNI scaned by two sides with a request for what right you want to exercise.
To request your data you need to contact customer service.
Send an email requesting a copy of your data to privacy@zoom.us.
Select the game you want to request your data from. Enter your Player ID and PIN for that game. Click on 'Request a Copy of Your Account Data' to submit your request.
